title: OperatorUsabilityMetrics
description: Schema for machine-readable quantitative operator friction and adoption readiness metrics conforming to RFC 0002 §7 (Track D).

timeToInstallSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from deciding to install to successful verification via doctor or smoke run.

timeToFirstSuccessfulAuditSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds until the first audit run finishes with valid SARIF/report output.

timeToFirstUnderstoodFindingSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds until the operator comprehends the first vulnerability finding or clean assurance verdict.

manualFilesOpenedCount.description: Number of raw files, manifests, or traces the operator had to open manually to understand the result.

rerunsRequiredCount.description: Number of times the audit had to be rerun due to configuration ambiguity, syntax failure, or timeout.

commandsRetriedCount.description: Number of times CLI commands were retried due to misleading error messages or missing arguments.

helpRequestsCount.description: Number of times the operator needed to look at --help, README, or RFC docs to unblock execution.

misinterpretedStatusesCount.description: Number of times status vocabulary (READY, DEGRADED, UNVERIFIABLE, DISPUTED) was misunderstood.

findingAdjudicationSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds spent adjudicating and verifying evidence for candidate findings.

evidenceFilesManuallyInspectedCount.description: Number of distinct evidence envelopes, raw streams, or ground truth files manually reviewed.

operatorFrictionNotes.description: Concrete operational observations and friction points recorded during the session.

evaluatedInterfaceRecommendation.description: Empirical interface decision recommendation derived conforming to RFC 0002 §7.2.
